title: Traffic Jumper
description: A top-down Frogger-style game where you must cross lanes of moving traffic, with increasing speed and density each stage. Avoid cars or face a bloody splat!
prompt:
Top down game where you have to jump over lanes of traffic (all traffic moves one direction left to right) to get to the other side, over time/stages speed and density gets higher to progressively increase difficulty.

If you get hit by - giant blood splat goes over the screen.
